svg.text: Same feed on a phone: the band keeps chip, name and status; the rail is time alone; badges go under commands; nothing scrolls the page sideways.
Check the links at 390 too, as
Every band on a phone is one line, 44px,
stuck or not: chip, name, status badge,
duration. Team, role, turn id and tokens
stay in its accessible name and come back
Commands wrap to the column. The badge
drops under the box, left; ‘Show all’ sits
beside it. 44px hit area on both.
Rail: 56px, time only. Durations move into
the band. Bands still name every author:
Not stuck, the same one line. Nothing
changes when a band sticks, so no script
and no jump between two heights.
Links wrap with the text; their underline
and ↗ go with them. Inline links in
sentences are exempt from target size.
A table wider than the column scrolls in
its own box (thin scrollbar shown); the
page never scrolls sideways. Fences too.
Newest (after 200px of scroll) sits at the
bottom right of the scroller, 16px in, 32px
tall with a 44px hit area: it covers rail
times passing under it, never a band's
author. Was top centre, over the band.
